name: ViRility
source:
In the near future, Virtual Reality Gaming will surpass all other major league sports in worldwide popularity. Driven by cutting edge technology, Virtual Worlds aren’t just created visually but now use all the senses to create a completely immersive experience. And the best players don’t just watch and manipulate a few hand controls. They are athletes whose bodies are projected into fantastical worlds where they compete using their physical and mental skills.

You are a young man with dreams of becoming a professional gamer in this trillion-dollar industry. After having made your reputation on the amateur circuit, you’ve just been accepted into the training program for the professional teams. Officially called Virtual Reality University, it is commonly known by its nickname, ViRility.

But a trillion-dollar industry attracts a wide range of characters: gorgeous athletes, brilliant strategists, jealous schemers, and organized criminals – sometimes wrapped up in the same person. You’ll have to negotiate this minefield of relationships, ethical choices, and danger while training to become the next gaming celebrity.

And having a lot of sex!

What choices will you make?

[From [url=https://vstoryteller.itch.io/virility]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
在不久的将来，虚拟现实竞技将在全球范围内超越其他所有顶级职业体育联赛，成为最受欢迎的运动。在尖端科技的驱动下，虚拟世界不再停留于视觉层面，而是调动全部感官营造出彻底沉浸的真实体验。顶尖选手们也不再只是盯着屏幕摆弄手柄——他们是将自身躯体投射进奇幻世界、凭体魄与心智技巧同台竞技的真正运动员。

你是一名怀揣梦想的年轻男子，渴望在这座价值数万亿美元的庞大产业中成为职业电竞选手。在业余巡回赛上闯出名堂后，你刚刚获准进入职业战队青训营——这所官方名称为“虚拟现实大学”的机构，在圈内普遍被昵称为“雄风”（ViRility）。

然而万亿美元规模的产业自然会吸引三教九流的人物：美艳动人的女选手、算无遗策的战术大师、善妒阴险的野心家，乃至有组织的黑帮罪犯——有时这几种身份甚至集于同一人之身。在刻苦训练迈向下一代电竞巨星的途中，你必须在人际纠葛、道德抉择与重重危机交织的雷区中小心周旋。

当然，还要尽情享受火辣性爱！

你将做出怎样的抉择？
